item.title: Transparency advocate endorses Attao-Villagomez ticket
item.description: U.S. Army veteran Fabian Indalecio, who advocates for government transparency, last week pledged his “strong support” to the independent gubernatorial tandem of Rep. Blas Jonathan Tenorio Attao and Speaker Edmund Sablan Villagomez. The post Transparency advocate endorses Attao-Villagomez ticket appeared first on Marianas Variety News & Views.

item.title: CNMI leaders seek federal action to restore air service
item.description: CNMI leaders are calling for targeted federal action to restore critical air service and revive the Commonwealth’s tourism-driven economy, emphasizing that the community is “all in this together.” The post CNMI leaders seek federal action to restore air service appeared first on Marianas Variety News & Views.

item.title: CNMI eyes $429M lifeline in federal talks
item.description: THE CNMI panel in the Covenant Section 902 consultation with U.S. officials is proposing a $429.1 million multi-year financial assistance program to address the Commonwealth’s long-standing structural, geographic, and federal policy-driven constraints that continue to limit its ability to achieve economic growth and fiscal stability. The post CNMI eyes $429M lifeline in federal talks appeared first on Marianas Variety News & Views.

item.title: Dispute erupts over 60-day window in budget override
item.description: GOVERNOR David M. Apatang and the presiding officers of the Legislature are in dispute over the recent override of the revised fiscal year 2026 budget. The post Dispute erupts over 60-day window in budget override appeared first on Marianas Variety News & Views.

item.title: T’way, Jeju confirm summer flights to Saipan
item.description: TWO major South Korean low‑cost carriers will maintain summer service to Saipan, the Marianas Visitors Authority announced Thursday. MVA Managing Director Jamika Taijeron, joined by Board Chair Warren Villagomez and Tourism Recovery Task Force Chair Alex Sablan, confirmed the schedules during a press conference. The post T’way, Jeju confirm summer flights to Saipan appeared first on Marianas Variety News & Views.

item.title: Trump ousts Kristi Noem, names Oklahoma senator as homeland security nominee
item.description: WASHINGTON (Reuters) — Kristi Noem, who oversaw President Donald Trump's aggressive immigration crackdown and faced bipartisan criticism in hearings this week, will leave her role as homeland security chief at the end ​of the month. The post Trump ousts Kristi Noem, names Oklahoma senator as homeland security nominee appeared first on Marianas Variety News & Views.

item.title: Fuel prices soar again in NMI
item.description: JUST two days after a 20-cent hike on Tuesday, fuel prices in the CNMI soared again Thursday night as war in the Middle East continues to escalate, with recent reports of missile attacks on oil refineries. The post Fuel prices soar again in NMI appeared first on Marianas Variety News & Views.

item.title: US House passes bipartisan bill to guarantee in-state tuition for CNMI and other territorial students
item.description: The bill updates the Higher Education Act of 1965 to require federally funded public institutions to charge eligible territorial students no more than in-state tuition. Out-of-state tuition can be two to three times higher than in-state rates, creating a significant financial burden for CNMI families who already face higher costs of living and limited local degree programs. item.title: Public urged to stay out of waters as hazardous surf hits Marianas
item.description: A broad tropical disturbance developing to the southwest of the Marianas and a shear line across the CNMI will lead to an increase in north to northeast swell. This will also cause a high risk of rip currents along east facing reefs through the weekend. The post Public urged to stay out of waters as hazardous surf hits Marianas appeared first on Marianas Variety News & Views.
